The Shade design system

A dark-first design system for desktop work tools, with a matching light mode, built as Avalonia components.

13 colour roles · 1 accent · Inter at 5 sizes · 4 px grid · 28 px controls

Thirteen roles named by their job, plus the shades the rules make from them. Every value below is read from the code, for the mode you're viewing.

Status

Fixed per mode; never the accent.

Success#83CEA5#1F8A57OK, completed
Warning#FFB142#A86400Retrying, incomplete
Danger#E0685C#C4453AFailed, deletes, actions that change the outside world
Danger tint#392729#F6E3E1The Danger button's fill
Info#6FA8DC#2C6CB0Overrides, notices

Accent picker

Curated accents have a value for each mode; the palette and mixer take any colour. The whole page follows, by Look.SetAccent's rules.

Rules

Shades are computed, never stored.

  • Tint: 15 % of a colour over Raised.
  • Hover: 10 % lighter.
  • On a colour: dark ink or white, whichever reads better.
  • Lifted text: accent and danger text move toward the high-contrast end until 4.5:1.
  • A status colour always sits next to its word.

Writing

How labels read.

  • Sentence case: “Create project”, not “Create Project”.
  • Actions are verbs and never end in dots: “Sync”.
  • Work in progress keeps them: “Connecting…”.

08 / Responsive

Responsive

Blocks reflow into as many masonry columns as fit. Drag the corner of the box to resize it; this whole page does the same with the window. Compare with the Avalonia render: darklight.

General

Email

Notifications

Storage

Appearance

Privacy

  • A masonry fits as many columns as reach its minimum width (140 px here, about 300 on a page), up to three; each block goes to the shortest column.
  • Page headers keep their title left and actions right; the hint wraps. Tables scroll inside their area under a header that stays.
  • The sidebar is 180 px, or 54 px collapsed: try it in Navigation above.
